state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul`: stage 5 (Install and Guides) is done. Stage 6 (In-Depth, the home page and the last links) is next.**

Install has four pages and Guides has all eight sections. Why people pick Novis has 11 candidate pages, and the user curates that list when the goal lands. Example apps has `index.mdx` and `notes.mdx`.

The Notes app is in `apps/notes/`: `nvs.toml` with two SQLite databases (`notes`, a file, and `scratch`, in memory, used only by `tests/StoreTest.nvs`), `public/index.nvs`, five classes under `src/` in namespace `Notes`, and 11 tests under `tests/`. `nvs test tests/` and `nvs serve public/index.nvs` run from the app's folder. Routes are dispatched by name in `Notes\App::handle` (`apps/notes/src/App.nvs`). The app has no login and no CSRF token, and its page says so.

`bun nv site --check apps` (`appsProblems` in `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts`) runs `nvs test tests/` in each app under `apps/`, then boots `nvs serve` on a free port until `GET /` returns 200, and deletes every file the run created (the `notes.sqlite`).

Green now: `site structure`, `stale`, `reference`, `syntax`, `guides`, `apps` and `--build`. `snippets` and `prose` fail only on `index.mdx`, `sponsoring.mdx` and `in-depth/what-changed.mdx`. `in-depth` is the last `LATER` stub.

A page whose `covers:` names a feature id needs `bun nv site --stamp <page>` before `--check stale` passes. MDX reads `{...}` outside a code span as an expression, so keep route paths like `/notes/{id}` in backticks.

next.title: In-Depth, the home page and the last links

items.text: **In-Depth's eight sections**: What Novis is for, What Novis will never be, How we decide, Design principles, Concepts (five pages), Where Novis falls behind, Roadmap, What changed. Each is a short essay that links to decision records through `decisionRecord` in `website/config/site.mjs`. Specified by `docs/agent/goals/side/website-overhaul.md` § Stage 6. Anchors: `website/astro.config.ts:368`, `website/src/content/docs/in-depth/index.mdx:1`

**`--check in-depth`**: replace the last `LATER` entry with a part that checks the eight sections exist and each has a page, and make `structure` fail on a link to a URL the site does not build. Anchors: `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts:67`, `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts:689`

**The home page and the last prose**: rewrite `index.mdx` (hero, one `<Snippet>`, 4–6 standout features linking to their Why-Novis pages, four area cards, Install button), and bring `sponsoring.mdx` and `in-depth/what-changed.mdx` inside `snippets` and `prose`. Anchors: `website/src/content/docs/index.mdx:1`, `website/src/components/Footer.astro:23`
**Close the goal**: `bun nv verify --doc`, `bun nv owners --closes website-overhaul`, every `site --check` part green, then `DONE`. Anchors: `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts:63`

backlog: CI: check that the workflow that runs `site --check` builds `nvs` first, so `apps` has a binary (`.github/workflows/`, not checked).
Notes app: a login and CSRF tokens are the obvious next example (`Core\Csrf`, `Core\Session`). The goal names one app for now (`docs/agent/goals/side/website-overhaul.md` § Stage 5).
The user curates the Why-Novis list when the goal lands (goal § Standing decisions).
